needsYou.description: Open, not a draft, and not yet handled by you.

testsTotal.description: Check runs of the head commit (a re-run replaces the earlier run of the same name).

testsPassed.description: Of those, completed with success, neutral or skipped.

testsFailed.description: Of those, completed with any other conclusion.

PullCounts.description: Size of each inbox tab, over every repo of the project.

patch.description: GitHub's unified diff; null for binary files and diffs that are too large.

checks.description: CI check runs of the head commit, failures first.

checksState.description: `none` when no check run is stored (not synced, or the repo has no CI).

conclusion.description: GitHub's: success, failure, neutral, cancelled, skipped, timed_out, action_required, stale; null until completed.

headSha.description: The commit the review was left on.

root.description: Folder holding the `spec` folder, '' at the top of the repo.

area.description: Folders between `spec/` and the file, '' when flat.

tested.description: Requirements with at least one test anchored to them or to their step.

devpage.description: The spec as devpage server renders it, on this origin; null while devpage is off or has not published it.

SpecModel.description: Null when the file has errors; see diagnostics.

get.summary: Liveness plus a database round trip

200.description: The Worker and its database are up

get.summary: GitHub redirects back here; starts a session

204.description: Session ended (also when there was none)

get.summary: Start installing the GitHub App (redirects to GitHub)
GitHub redirects back here after the App is installed
Repositories the signed-in user's installations can reach

post.description: Called by GitHub, not by the web app. Needs `X-Hub-Signature-256`, `X-GitHub-Event` and `X-GitHub-Delivery`. Handles `pull_request`, `pull_request_review`, `check_suite`, `check_run` and `push`; other events are acknowledged and ignored.

200.description: Accepted (`handled` is false for events we do not use)

delete.summary: Delete a project and its repositories

post.summary: Index every repository of the project again

200.description: The project, with its repos back to pending

post.summary: Add a repository to a project
post.description: Accepts owner/repo or a GitHub link. The repository must be one the GitHub App is installed on for the signed-in user, and not already in the project.

repo.description: owner/repo, or a link to the repository on GitHub

403.description: Not reachable through the user's GitHub App installations

delete.summary: Remove a repository from a project

post.summary: Queue a job for a project (owner only)

get.summary: WebSocket: live job events for a project
get.description: Upgrade to a WebSocket. Each text frame is one JSON event `{id, projectId, jobId, event, data, createdAt}`. Pass `after=<last event id>` to replay what was missed; without it, only new events are sent.

post.summary: Pull from GitHub: queue a sync of the project's pull requests (owner only)
post.description: Queues the same `sync` job as `POST /jobs`. Follow it with `GET /jobs/{id}` or the project's event socket. If a sync for the same repos is already queued or running, that job is returned instead of a second one.

202.description: The sync job, queued or already in flight

get.summary: The project's pull requests, for the inbox
get.description: `filter` is the inbox tab: `needs` (open, not a draft, not yet handled by you), `open`, `merged`, or `all` (default). `repo` (`owner/name`) narrows the list to one repo; `counts` always covers every repo. Needs-you PRs come first, then the most recently updated.

get.summary: The unified diff of each changed file
get.description: Kept apart from the pull request so the page loads without it. Files are in the same order as `files` on the pull request.

get.summary: One pull request: header, description and changed files
The reviews you left on a pull request from spectrace, newest first

post.summary: Approve a pull request or request changes (owner only)
post.description: Leaves a review on GitHub as the App, on the PR's current head commit, and records it. An approval takes the PR out of `needs` until its head moves. `request_changes` needs a `body`.

409.description: Not open, a draft, or GitHub refused (not mergeable, or the head moved)

502.description: GitHub could not be reached or refused the call

post.summary: Merge a pull request on GitHub (owner only)
post.description: Merges the PR at the head commit spectrace last saw (`squash` unless `method` says otherwise). GitHub refuses when the PR is not mergeable or its head has moved; that comes back as 409 and a sync will refresh it.

409.description: Not open, a draft, or GitHub refused (not mergeable, or the head moved)

502.description: GitHub could not be reached or refused the call

get.summary: Specs of a project's repos, by repo and path
One spec: source, parsed model, diagnostics and the code and tests anchored to it
